title: Q-BORROW-compare-page: publish a sourced comparison page at /compare
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** cmd:grep -q /compare site/worker.js
**Status:** open

Render a page at /compare from doctrine/competitors.json: each competitor's name, the capabilities its profile in ops/rnd/profiles/ evidences with the source link, and its plug_in row (role, status, default). Every sentence comes from the data; no number without a source (NO-FABRICATION-1). Register the route as a claim and add a test in site/site.test.mjs that the page lists every competitor id.

**Closing probe:** cmd:grep -q /compare site/worker.js

**Prediction:** spec_quality >= 0.7 within 336 h (read by `python3 -m foundation specgate --report`)

**Out of scope:** hand-typed claims about competitors, rankings, or pricing figures.
